isolationSpectrum.heading: The Isolation Spectrum
isolationSpectrum.intro: Not every workload needs a dedicated server. A web scraper does not have the same threat model as a financial trading agent. Foundry provides three tiers of compute, each matched to a risk profile.

standard.name: Standard Instance
standard.useCase: Web scraping, data processing, non-sensitive automation

secure.name: Secure Instance
secure.useCase: Untrusted third-party code, plugin execution, multi-tenant SaaS agents

sovereign.name: Sovereign Host
sovereign.useCase: Financial agents, PII processing, credential-holding workloads

wholesale.title: Wholesale hardware
wholesale.desc: Runs on wholesale bare-metal pricing, a fraction of hyperscaler list prices for equivalent compute.

lifecycle.title: Scheduled lifecycle
lifecycle.desc: Hibernates idle instances to cold storage. Near-100% fleet utilization.

noTax.title: No hyperscaler tax
noTax.desc: No egress fees, no per-request charges, no monitoring upsells.
